notFail: Nothing observed contradicts a future native/PWA cutover. What is missing is the evidence, and this record does not manufacture it.

facts.nativeSourceInRepository: ABSENT. No *.swift, *.kt, *.java, *.pbxproj, AndroidManifest, capacitor.config or twa-manifest is tracked; dossier row S-455 records the same absence.
facts.nativeBinaryOutsideRepository: The Google Play package folder on the owner's machine holds a signed .aab/.apk and a Readme; neither states a start URL in text. It was read only, never modified.
facts.androidAppLinks: https://malesthetic.pro/.well-known/assetlinks.json answers 200 and delegates handle_all_urls to pro.malesthetic.twa.
facts.webBundlesReferenceNativeBridges: The committed app.html references Capacitor.Plugins 31 times, including the custom MayaRuntime and MayaNfcWriter plugins, whose native implementation is not in the repository.
facts.whatAWrapperWouldShowToday: Both /app/ entries serve the maintenance page (three-bundle-probe.json), so a wrapper whose start URL is either of them shows maintenance.
facts.ownerIntentOnRecord: docs/rebuild/evidence/chapter7-wave3-fixture-recovery/maintenance-provenance.json records the owner's 2026-09-08 instruction: close the PWA temporarily behind a maintenance page, and use the native Maya app once it is finished. Recorded here as provenance, not as a new instruction.

surfacesBlockedByAnOutOfRepositoryNative.rule: A retiring row whose channel is native-shell, or whose function lives in a native plugin or custom URL scheme, is NOT retired until the native change exists and is proven. It is returned as an exact blocker, not deleted.

doesTheWebCutoverRequireIt: Mapping §6 (D11-B) defines one Web Interaction Contract for native and PWA, with parity 'proved rather than asserted'. The 18 native-shell rows depend on native evidence. The remaining web rows do not depend on it by contract. They are blocked for their own reasons, recorded elsewhere.
